reason: Release 56: #2074 (claude/no-landing-clearance): her blink, ley jump and every throw land where they take her, through trees, rocks, soundsystems, speakers and the treehouse; only a lake on foot or the zoo's fence stops them (Ed, 2026-11-13: "There's nothing to collide with apart from lakes"; "Drop all of them"). The party witches round the floor keep their clearance.; #2073 (claude/effect-marks): Stun on her becomes slow, effects shown on her, and element-coloured telegraphs (Ed, 2026-11-13: "I think stun and slow are very similar, and stun is less fun than slow, so how about stun is replaced with slow and we use circling stars?", "Big: 40% speed, 3× as long"; "Mark + tint + sound"; "Element coloured warning shape on the ground", "Let's try element colours and see"). Rules: a creature's stun on her (the lynx's pounce, the ram's headbutt, the lion's roar, the sphinx's gaze) no longer staggers her; it slows her to 40% of her speed for three times the stun's length (witch.stunAsSlow). View: while she's slowed, stars circle her head and her steps leave drag marks; confused, a spiral over her head; thrown hard, a dust skid; her sprite tinted with the attacker's element colour; and every wild attack's warning shape drawn in its attacker's element colour, not red.; #2072 (claude/hare-badger): The hare stamps, then sits; the badger's barge throws her 20 m (Ed, 2026-11-13: "Stamp, then sit 0.8 s"; "20m"; "let's start with big numbers and dial it down, at least we can then perceive the effects!"; after the attack legibility audit, docs/plans/attack-legibility-audit.md). The hare's pack bolt is gone from its actions (config/creature-actions.json: its strike is its stamp), its bound in on its turn lands it in the stamp's reach (rules/combat.ts), and it sits tuning hareStamp.sit seconds after each stamp (a new optional creature field, sitUntil; a new still frame, its sitting pose, after its walk's and run's frames in the hare's mesh sprites). The badger's own lunge's blow at her throws her tuning badgerBarge.throw metres, past witch.knock.max, and staggers her badgerBarge.stagger seconds (rules/combat/hits.ts, rules/knock.ts). New knobs: hareStamp.sit, badgerBarge.throw, badgerBarge.stagger.

rules.*: wherever she blinks or is thrown near a tree, rock, soundsystem, speaker or the treehouse: she ends where the blink or throw takes her instead of short of it or nudged clear; wherever a lynx, ram, lion or sphinx lands its own attack on her: she is slowed (0.6 to 0.9 s at 40% speed) instead of held still (0.2 to 0.3 s), so her position and what follows from it (who reaches her, what she dodges) differ from then on; wherever a hare or a badger fights: the hare's actions drawn (no bolt), where it bounds, its stamps and sits, and what follows from them; where a badger's barge leaves her (20 m off, not 6.4) and for how long she's staggered; a throw that would cross the treehouse; and the new sitUntil field wherever a creature's fields are listed

frames.*: wherever a fight shows: its warning shapes in their element's colour, and the marks and tint on her while an effect is on her; wherever a hare or a badger is in a fight in view: the hare beside her, its stamp's ring and its sitting pose, no moon-dust bolts; her thrown far by a badger's barge; and the hare's sprite sheet one frame longer wherever its atlas is drawn
